sources.title: RFC8365 — EVPN network virtualization overlay
sources.locator: §5 EVPN with VXLAN; control-plane route interpretation

sources.title: Explicit educational fixture
sources.locator: scenarioVersion1; not live captures or a reproduced customer incident

sources.title: Conditional arithmetic and learning gates
sources.locator: payload+28 inner IPv4; payload+78 outer IPv4; scenario only

en.title: BGP EVPN state
en.why: Established sessions and installed EVPN routes establish signaling evidence, not packet delivery.
en.evidence: Both leaves: EVPN BGP ESTABLISHED; expected Type2 MAC routes imported with correct remote VTEP next hops; VNI10100 operational up.
en.limit: Rechecking is valid but cannot explain why only larger probes fail; resetting BGP is unsupported.

zh.title: BGP EVPN状态
zh.why: 会话建立和EVPN路由安装是信令证据，不是报文交付证明。
zh.evidence: 两端Leaf：EVPN BGP已建立；预期Type2 MAC路由已导入，远端VTEP下一跳正确；VNI10100运行正常。
zh.limit: 复查有效，但不能解释只有大包失败；没有证据支持重置BGP。

en.title: MAC learning and forwarding
en.why: Compare local attachment, remote reachability and installed forwarding entries for the actual endpoints.
en.evidence: CE-A 02:00:00:00:00:0a local on LeafA; CE-B 02:00:00:00:00:0b remote via VTEP192.0.2.12; LeafB has reciprocal entries in VNI10100.
en.limit: A present MAC route alone is not enough; this fixture also checks installed forwarding and correct service context.

zh.title: MAC学习与转发
zh.why: 比较实际端点的本地接入、远端可达性和已安装转发表。
zh.evidence: CE-A的MAC 02:00:00:00:00:0a在LeafA本地；CE-B的MAC 02:00:00:00:00:0b经VTEP192.0.2.12远端可达；LeafB在VNI10100有对称条目。
zh.limit: 仅存在MAC路由不够；此情景同时核查了已安装转发和正确业务上下文。

en.title: ARP / ND applicability
en.why: Verify the destination neighbor, not merely that any MAC/IP route exists.
en.evidence: CE-A198.51.100.10/24 resolves CE-B198.51.100.20 to02:00:00:00:00:0b; reverse ARP matches. Fresh32-byte ICMPv4 succeeds both ways. IPv6 ND is not exercised.
en.limit: IPv4 observations do not establish IPv6 ND health or every possible neighbor.

zh.title: ARP / ND适用性
zh.why: 验证目标邻居，而不是仅看到任意MAC/IP路由。
zh.evidence: CE-A198.51.100.10/24将CE-B198.51.100.20解析为02:00:00:00:00:0b；反向ARP匹配。新发32字节ICMPv4双向成功。未测试IPv6 ND。
zh.limit: IPv4观测不能证明IPv6 ND健康或所有邻居均正常。

en.title: VLAN / VNI mapping
en.why: Match the tenant service on both ends before blaming transport.
en.evidence: Both leaves: CE access VLAN100 maps to VNI10100; intended tenant/route-target import matches. No inner VLAN tag is carried in this fixture.
en.limit: Matching numbers alone do not prove forwarding; installed bridge entries and captures corroborate the mapping.

zh.title: VLAN / VNI映射
zh.why: 归因传输前，先比较两端租户业务映射。
zh.evidence: 两端Leaf：CE接入VLAN100映射VNI10100；目标租户与路由目标导入匹配。此情景不携带内层VLAN标签。
zh.limit: 编号相同不能单独证明转发，桥接条目与抓包相互印证。

en.title: Bridge domain membership
en.why: Confirm both access and tunnel attachments belong to the intended L2 domain.
en.evidence: BD100 contains the expected CE access attachment and VNI10100 tunnel attachment on each leaf; forwarding state active; endpoint MACs in this bridge domain.
en.limit: This excludes the modeled wrong-bridge hypothesis; it is not a platform-wide health certification.

zh.title: 桥域成员关系
zh.why: 确认接入与隧道归属目标二层桥域。
zh.evidence: 两端BD100均包含预期CE接入和VNI10100隧道成员；转发状态激活，端点MAC位于此桥域。
zh.limit: 此证据排除此模型的错误桥域假设，不是整个平台健康认证。

en.title: Interface state and counters
en.why: An up interface can still discard packets, so correlate packet class and counter changes.
en.evidence: CE links and underlay links up; no link flaps or CRC increments. During10 large probes per direction, the relevant constrained path egress MTU-drop counter increases by10 each way; small probes do not increase it.
en.limit: Counter names are semantic synthetic evidence, not vendor command output or a universal counter name.

zh.title: 接口状态与计数
zh.why: 接口up仍可能丢包，需关联报文类型与计数变化。
zh.evidence: CE链路与底层链路up，无链路抖动或CRC增长。每方向10个大包探测时，相应受限路径出口MTU丢弃计数各增加10；小包不增加。
zh.limit: 计数名称是合成语义证据，不是厂商命令输出或通用计数器名称。

en.title: Data-plane encapsulation
en.why: Compare the actual inner service and outer delivery envelope with the intended VTEP pair.
en.evidence: Synthetic pre-drop capture: inner IPv4 ICMP payload1472, inner IP1500; untagged inner Ethernet14; VXLAN8/VNI10100; UDP8/dst4789; outer IPv420/no options, src192.0.2.11 dst192.0.2.12 (reverse swapped), outer DF set, total outer IP1550.
en.limit: Outer Ethernet/FCS are excluded from IP MTU. IPv6, VLAN tags, options or extra tunnels change this model.

zh.title: 数据平面封装
zh.why: 比较实际内层业务、外层传输与目标VTEP对。
zh.evidence: 合成丢弃前抓包：内层ICMP载荷1472，内层IP1500；无标签内层以太网14；VXLAN8/VNI10100；UDP8/目标4789；外层IPv420/无选项，源192.0.2.11目标192.0.2.12（反向互换），外层DF置位，外层IP总长1550。
zh.limit: IP MTU不含外层以太网/FCS。IPv6、VLAN标签、选项或额外隧道会改变模型。

en.title: MTU and size boundary
en.why: Small-packet success does not test whether an encapsulated full-size frame fits.
en.evidence: Both directions before repair: payload32 => outer110 PASS;1422 =>1500 PASS;1423 =>1501 DROP;1472 =>1550 DROP. Limiting forwarding egress IP MTU1500. Outer DF/drop behavior is explicitly modeled; no delivered fragments.
en.limit: RFC7348 allows intermediate-router fragmentation in general; this fixture uses DF and explicit egress drop evidence.1600 is a later simulation profile, not a universal recommendation.

zh.title: MTU与尺寸边界
zh.why: 小包成功不能证明封装后的满尺寸帧可以通过。
zh.evidence: 修复前双向：载荷32→外层110通过；1422→1500通过；1423→1501丢弃；1472→1550丢弃。限制出口IP MTU1500。明确建模外层DF/丢弃，无已交付分片。
zh.limit: RFC7348一般情况下允许中间路由器分片；此情景使用DF与明确出口丢弃证据。后续1600是模拟配置档，不是通用建议。

en.title: Underlay reachability
en.why: Test the same path/directions and packet envelope, not just a VTEP small ping.
en.evidence: Both VTEP loopbacks reachable with small IP probes. Route/next-hop and small UDP4789 delivery are intact; oversized outer packets correlate with fragmentation-needed/MTU-drop evidence at the constrained egress in both directions. No ACL mismatch or second fault is modeled.
en.limit: Small reachability excludes total path loss, not MTU or every ECMP path. Real validation must cover relevant links/paths and both directions.

zh.title: 底层可达性
zh.why: 应测试相同路径、方向与报文尺寸，不能只看VTEP小ping。
zh.evidence: 小IP探测双向可达VTEP环回。路由/下一跳及小UDP4789交付正常；超大外层报文与两个方向受限出口的需分片/MTU丢弃证据相关。模型不含ACL错误或第二故障。
zh.limit: 小包可达排除完全路径中断，不排除MTU或所有ECMP路径。实际验证须覆盖相关链路、路径及双向。

en.title: Anycast / gateway assumptions
en.why: Decide whether the packet traverses a gateway before diagnosing one.
en.evidence: CE-A and CE-B are in198.51.100.0/24 and the same bridged service; they resolve each other directly. No IRB/default-gateway hop is traversed. Anycast gateway behavior is not applicable to this path.
en.limit: This does not claim routed inter-subnet or IPv6 gateway traffic is healthy; those cases require additional checks.

zh.title: 任播 / 网关假设
zh.why: 诊断网关前，应判断报文是否经过网关。
zh.evidence: CE-A和CE-B位于198.51.100.0/24和同一桥接业务，直接解析对方；不经过IRB/默认网关。任播网关行为不适用于此路径。
zh.limit: 此结论不代表跨子网路由或IPv6网关流量正常；那些情形需要额外检查。
